Corank counts codimensions, independently of ordinary data rank and extents. PENDING scalar/rank-one/rank-two contexts with coranks1/2 under R809/R810/R811, not RANK or fixed-destination proxies for corank.

The coarray-spec can specify corank and cobounds or just corank pending allocation/association. Data bounds/shape and cobounds/coshape retain separate owners; no inquiry into unavailable allocatable cobounds.
PDF121 lines22-23; the two alternatives retain R810/R811 ownership.

Original NOTE1 on PDF122 permits the stated derived component categories; it does not supply a remote pointer-value oracle.
A coarray of derived type can have pointer components in their eligible contexts. A pointer component is not automatically a coarray or a remotely valid target.
Allocatable components are possible, with their own allocation/definition/lifetime and segment-order conditions. Existing component cases keep their original owners.

The hypothetical implementation explanation does not mandate a real barrier on every procedure entry. New runtime plans use explicit source-required synchronization, not timing.
Nondummy explicit-shape local coarrays need SAVE in the stated setting. Nonconstant cobounds are not themselves the nonconstant data bounds/type parameters of8.3's automatic-object definition.

requirements.title: Coarray specifications use deferred-list or explicit-coshape syntax
requirements.definition: A coarray-spec is either a nonempty deferred-coshape-spec list or an explicit-coshape-spec. The declaration's ALLOCATABLE and entity context determine which route is eligible; ordinary array shape is a separate specification.

pending.deferred-admission: PENDING compile controls for INTEGER ALLOCATABLE scalar x[:] and rank-one x(:)[:,:], with proper complete scopes. R810/C827 own colon details; no unallocated cobound inquiry or runtime effect is inferred.
pending.explicit-admission: PENDING nonallocatable saved scalar x[*] and saved rank-one x(2)[0:1,5:*], with rank and corank counted independently. R811/C828 retain their precise roles.
pending.empty-specification: PENDING complete main-program INTEGER declaration with an empty coarray-spec, repaired solely to[*]. Require a located empty/missing coarray specification cause, not disabled coarrays or generic END recovery.
pending.rank-corank-source-use: PENDING source-use of attribute versus entity suffix and ordinary array versus coarray brackets. Preserve8.2p2, R814 and component C751 owners; no CORANK/COSHAPE extension or fixed-destination proxy is invented.

requirements.oracle: Qualified grammar admission/report-control plans; every repair is otherwise conforming and selected coarray configuration must actually support the language context.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Compile admission is not cross-image behavior. Unsupported/disabled coarray facilities, toolchain/runtime mismatches, echoes, crashes and recovery do not diagnose this grammar.

requirements.title: The sum of ordinary rank and corank is at most fifteen
requirements.definition: An entity's ordinary rank plus its corank cannot exceed15. Data extents, total element count, cobound values and image count do not substitute for either rank count.

pending.sum-sixteen: PENDING finite nonallocatable saved coarray declarations with rank14/corank2 and rank1/corank15. Use constant extent-one data dimensions and valid explicit coshape; remove one codimension for each repair while retaining data rank/type/role. Require the combined rank/corank limit cause, not an implementation-specific lower rank limit or disabled coarrays.
pending.sum-fifteen: PENDING boundary compile admissions rank14/corank1, rank1/corank14, rank0/corank15 and rank8/corank7, with valid scopes/coshapes. These are measured declaration counts, not claims about all runtime configurations.
pending.smaller-sums: PENDING scalar/rank-one/rank-two coarrays with coranks1/2 as finite below-bound controls. Do not omit C826 lifetime or C827/C828 shape eligibility.
pending.extent-not-rank: PENDING source/control contrast of a rank-one extent20 coarray of corank1 versus the dimension-count boundary. Extent20 does not make the sum21; no payload need be read.

requirements.oracle: Count actual ordinary dimensions and codimensions in complete declarations, with focused dimension-removal repairs and separately qualified report causes.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No guessed storage sizes, kind widths, image-count substitution or new runtime profile. Ordinary0/nonzero reporting capability, not forced fatal rejection or a hardcoded diagnostic code.

requirements.title: A coarray is a component or a non-result variable
requirements.definition: A coarray is a component or a variable that is not a function result. The permitted categories retain their own component, allocation, lifetime and argument constraints.

pending.variable-admission: PENDING saved nonallocatable scalar/array coarrays and eligible allocatable/dummy coarrays in complete declarations. No initially undefined data is inspected.
pending.component-owner-source-use: PENDING canonical reuse of the C751 component-declaration controls, not cloned fixtures. Coarray components require ALLOCATABLE and deferred coshape; component eligibility is not an ordinary local-variable rule.
pending.function-result-excluded: PENDING a complete unreferenced function interface with scalar INTEGER ALLOCATABLE result r[:] so C826/C827 are independently satisfied. Repair only removal of the coarray suffix, preserving function/result identity, type, scalar rank and ALLOCATABLE. It is an interface-only compile control, not an undefined result returned by an executable function.
pending.other-role-source-use: PENDING constant/procedure/entity-role source distinctions. PARAMETER-coarray and procedure-pointer attempts have independent restrictions; do not use them as falsely isolated C823 negatives or change a result into an unrelated local variable for a repair.

requirements.oracle: Role-specific source and compile plans with a genuinely controlled function-result relation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No unallocated result use, expired pointer target, missing interface or unsupported facility can corroborate C823. Source admission and execution evidence remain distinct.

requirements.title: Three intrinsic-module types cannot be coarray types
requirements.definition: A coarray cannot have the intrinsic-module type C_PTR, C_FUNPTR or TEAM_TYPE. The restriction concerns actual type identity, not identifier spelling or a recursive ban on every containing type.

pending.c-ptr: PENDING a saved/main-program scalar coarray of ISO_C_BINDING C_PTR, repaired only to ordinary INTEGER while retaining its coshape and role. No opaque value, representation or pointer address is inspected.
pending.c-funptr: PENDING the corresponding C_FUNPTR coarray/type repair with all declaration premises fixed. It is not a procedure-pointer test.
pending.team-type: PENDING the corresponding ISO_FORTRAN_ENV TEAM_TYPE coarray/type repair. A default-initialized TEAM_TYPE object does not identify a team; no integer conversion or raw component inspection is a control.
pending.module-identity-source-use: PENDING exact intrinsic import/renaming versus unrelated same-spelled user-type contexts, retaining the existing C752 identity witnesses. Source name matching alone cannot prove the forbidden type and no component program is re-owned.
pending.wrapped-handles-source-use: PENDING relation to S10_2_1_3_023_valid__cross_image, whose coarray wrapper contains opaque fields but observes only an ordinary defined payload. Preserve its context-only role and two-image declaration; do not read the copied opaque results or call the wrapper itself one of the banned types.

requirements.oracle: Three exact type-identity report/control families and canonical source boundaries, with otherwise eligible coarray declarations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No new representation profile, C companion, team-value fabrication or remote opaque-value trap. The historical GNU14.4 calibration is not GNU16 evidence and is not rerun.

requirements.title: Coarray-potential-subobject types exclude pointer, coarray and result entities
requirements.definition: An entity whose type has a coarray potential subobject component is neither a pointer, a coarray nor a function result. Potential-subobject recursion follows7.5.1p5; it is not the ultimate-component rule or arbitrary pointer reachability. C753 imposes additional restrictions on data components of such types.

pending.pointer-excluded: PENDING complete type t with an INTEGER ALLOCATABLE coarray component q[:], and a main-program pointer of type t. Main-program implicit SAVE discharges C826. Remove only POINTER from the root declaration; no association/value is used.
pending.coarray-excluded: PENDING main-program root of that type t with an additional outer coarray suffix. Remove only the root suffix, preserving the legal allocatable inner coarray component and the root's lifetime context.
pending.function-result-gate: PENDING complete interface-only function with ALLOCATABLE scalar result of type t, so C826 is not independently violated. A focused type-definition repair removes only the inner component's coarray suffix while retaining its ALLOCATABLE scalar role, result type name and result attributes. Independently qualify the full interface context before a diagnostic fixture; no executable undefined result is claimed.
pending.recursive-potential-source-use: PENDING direct and two-level nonpointer nonallocatable scalar component chains containing the allocatable coarray. Keep C753 eligibility of intervening components and7.5.1 potential-versus-ultimate recursion; do not invent a legal pointer/allocatable component of a coarray-potential type as a shortcut.
pending.eligible-root-contexts: PENDING ordinary saved, allocatable and eligible dummy/associate root objects that are not themselves pointers/coarrays/results. Allocation/component state and C826 conditions stay explicit, with no constructor or lifetime evidence borrowed from unrelated cases.

requirements.oracle: Focused forbidden root properties with complete legal component definitions and repaired contexts; recursive source relationships remain separately qualified.
requirements.oracle_limitation: C753/component violations, missing C826 lifetime attributes, incomplete function interfaces and unsupported coarray components are not substitute causes. No raw reachability graph or new SourceUses instance is authored.

requirements.title: Coarray-bearing objects need an allowed lifetime or association context
requirements.definition: A coarray or object with a coarray potential subobject component is an associate name or dummy argument, or has ALLOCATABLE or SAVE. These alternatives do not waive C823/C825, component constraints, automatic-object restrictions or the specific association rules.

pending.local-scalar-save: PENDING complete procedure with a nonallocatable nondummy INTEGER scalar coarray, no initializer and no SAVE. Repair only addition of SAVE. All bounds/type parameters are constant; no implicit-SAVE route already satisfies the condition.
pending.local-array-save: PENDING the same contrast for an ordinary fixed-shape INTEGER array of extent2 with explicit coshape. Add only SAVE; do not use a nonconstant data bound that would make the repair violate C814.
pending.potential-object-save: PENDING ordinary local object of a complete type with a legal ALLOCATABLE coarray component, with no root ALLOCATABLE/SAVE/initialization. Add only root SAVE. The component's initial unallocated status does not imply SAVE for its container.
pending.dummy-and-allocatable-admission: PENDING complete eligible nonallocatable/allocatable coarray dummy and allocatable-root declarations. Use correct explicit/deferred coshapes, interfaces, actual attributes and INTENT; an INTENT(OUT) object with an allocatable coarray subobject can introduce a separate prohibition.
pending.associate-name-source-use: PENDING ASSOCIATE/SELECT TYPE/SELECT RANK and CHANGE TEAM relationships under11.1.3.3/19.5.1.6/5.4.8. An allocatable selector in ASSOCIATE/SELECT TYPE must be allocated, and ordinary associate names inherit corank/cobounds while CHANGE TEAM uses its codimension-decl. Do not manufacture a new declaration coarray-spec or ignore selector establishment.
pending.automatic-and-implied-save-boundaries: PENDING original NOTE2 and8.3/8.4/8.5.16 reconciliation. Adding SAVE cannot repair an automatic coarray with a nonconstant ordinary data bound. Conversely, nonconstant cobounds alone are not8.3's automatic predicate, and initialization/main/module/submodule may already imply SAVE. These are source qualifications, not new traps or duplicated C814 work.

requirements.oracle_limitation: No declaration-time coarray value read, false automatic-object repair, implicit entry barrier, missing association state or unsupported configuration is accepted. All future multi-image behavior needs a matched compiler/runtime/launcher and defined, ordered data; compile controls do not supply that evidence.
